features.text: PRECISE ROM ADJUSTMENT: Hinges lock in 15° increments to control flexion and extension during recovery.
3-POINT LEVERAGE SYSTEM: Promotes progressive extension and joint realignment to relieve stiffness and contractures.
DUAL-MODE FUNCTION: Provides both dynamic (motion) and static (stabilization) support for versatile rehabilitation.
EASY-USE DESIGN: Simple strap and hinge setup for fast donning and removal by patients or caregivers.
THERAPEUTIC RANGE-OF-MOTION TRAINING: Ideal for post-injury, post-surgery, and joint-contracture management.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
